self_sha256_note: This preregistration config deliberately does NOT embed its own SHA256 to avoid a self-reference paradox. The external SHA256 is recorded by the run report, the report preregistration and the harness result JSON.
scope: Parameter-free task-specific spatial supervision target feasibility audit. TRAIN split only. Zero-update: no optimizer, no training, no new Wt/Wv, no checkpoint. CPU-only float64 metrics. No 4B model load, no GPU, no network, no package installation. No val/test NPZ resolution, hashing, opening or scoring. No CV-Bench. Raw image bytes are never read.
preregistered_before_metrics: This file is written before any new per-sample or aggregate spatial-target audit metric is computed.
immutability_rule: All six pinned inputs must be byte-for-byte unchanged before and after the audit run; the report records the pre-run and post-run SHA256 of every pinned input.

data_contract.join: For every TRAIN sample, join the feature index and the clean manifest by sample_id. Hard-fail if a sample_id is missing from either side, if a sample_id is duplicated on either side, if index.task != manifest.task, or if the image identity (manifest coco_image_id and manifest image path) is inconsistent inside one source_image_sha256 group.
data_contract.task_pair_completeness: Every TRAIN source_image_sha256 group must contain exactly one grounding record and one pointing record (set == {grounding, pointing}); otherwise hard-fail.
data_contract.grid_contract: Require group_count == grid_h * grid_w for every TRAIN sample; otherwise stop with BLOCKED_DATA_CONTRACT.
data_contract.coordinate_convention: Manifest coordinates are normalized [0,1000]. Grid cell (r,c) of a grid H x W covers [1000*c/W, 1000*(c+1)/W] x [1000*r/H, 1000*(r+1)/H]. The flat group index is row-major: g = r*W + c.
data_contract.group_mean: cached group_mean:float16[G,1024] loaded train-only and cast to float64 for the L2 baseline; never uploaded.

split_rule.val_test_action: never resolved, hashed, opened or scored

frozen_spatial_targets.no_blending: The spatial targets are NEVER blended with the cached semantic teacher target in this audit.
frozen_spatial_targets.no_tuning: The formulas below are frozen before any metric is computed and are not tuned after seeing metrics.

grounding_area_target.formula: clip bbox to [0,1000] for numerical boundary tolerance only; area[r*W+c] = max(0, min(x2,cx2)-max(x1,cx1)) * max(0, min(y2,cy2)-max(y1,cy1)); divide by total intersection area so mass sums to 1.
grounding_area_target.hard_fail: invalid (non-finite or non-length-4) bbox; x2 <= x1 or y2 <= y1 after clip (zero/negative area); total intersection area <= 0

pointing_bilinear_target.formula: u = x*W/1000 - 0.5, v = y*H/1000 - 0.5; clamp u to [0,W-1], v to [0,H-1]; c0=floor(u), c1=min(c0+1,W-1), r0=floor(v), r1=min(r0+1,H-1), fu=u-c0, fv=v-r0; mass (1-fu)(1-fv) at (r0,c0), fu(1-fv) at (r0,c1), (1-fu)fv at (r1,c0), fu*fv at (r1,c1); duplicate boundary indices are combined and the result is normalized to sum to 1. No Gaussian and no bandwidth parameter.
pointing_bilinear_target.hard_fail: non-finite or non-length-2 point; point outside [-1e-9, 1000+1e-9]

metrics.independent_unit: image (grounding/pointing are paired, never two independent samples)
integrity_and_geometry: bbox validity, point validity, point-inside-bbox fraction
grid shape distribution and group_count == grid_h*grid_w fraction
support size, entropy (nats), effective support exp(entropy), max mass, per task
same_image_task_separation: JS divergence in nats, symmetric KL, TV, argmax-different fraction
top-K Jaccard / overlap / disagreement at K=48/64/96 with K_eff=min(K,G)
paired per-image difference spatial-semantic for JS, TV and top-K disagreement
metrics.semantic_teacher_comparator: cached teacher_soft_target only (no new semantic model)
metrics.semantic_spatial_compatibility: Spearman and full NDCG (K=G) between each spatial target and the cached semantic teacher target (relevance = teacher_soft_target), per task and overall; low agreement means the objectives differ, not automatically that one is wrong

hardware_regular_baseline.anchor_baseline: evaluation.hardware_regular_token_selector.select_real_groups exactly, fed the L2 saliency as the ranking score because no trained semantic projection exists in this zero-update audit; if the module cannot be imported the anchor baseline is reported NOT_COMPUTED instead of inventing one
hardware_regular_baseline.reported: for K=48/64/96, spatial-target NDCG and retained target mass for L2 and the available anchor baseline, by task and overall

statistics.multiple_comparison_policy: No multiple candidate search is performed; report raw two-sided p-values. No Holm correction is invented.
statistics.implementation: evaluation.prompt_identifiability_diagnostic.paired_effect for bootstrap/sign-flip/Cohen dz; median computed directly from the paired differences

decision_labels.SPATIAL_SUPERVISION_SIGNAL_PRESENT: Emitted only if all integrity checks pass AND the 95% bootstrap CI lower bound of (spatial-semantic) is greater than zero for BOTH JS and TV. Top-K results remain descriptive and cannot override this rule.
decision_labels.SPATIAL_SUPERVISION_SIGNAL_NOT_ESTABLISH: Emitted otherwise (all integrity checks pass but the joint JS+TV CI rule fails).
decision_labels.BLOCKED_DATA_CONTRACT: Emitted if joins, geometry, grid or isolation contracts fail.
decision_labels.learnability_caveat: Even when signal is present, learnability and downstream task accuracy remain untested.

prohibitions: no optimizer, no training, no parameter update, no new Wt/Wv, no checkpoint
no 4B model load, no inference, no GPU, no network, no package installation
no reading, resolving, hashing or scoring of val/test NPZ files
no reading of raw image bytes, model weights, keys, proxy files or credentials
no blending of the spatial targets with the semantic teacher
no formula tuning after seeing metrics
no multiple-candidate search, no Holm correction invented
no claim that a student can learn the target, no claim that downstream accuracy improves, no FPGA speedup claim
authorization: DeepSeek Harness may process necessary code, metrics and derived data via api.deepseek.com; raw images, 4B weights, keys, proxy config and credentials are never read, uploaded or printed.
